Sponsor.title: Support Notebook
Sponsor.subtitle: Every course on Notebook is free and open source. If one helped you, you can support the time that goes into writing and maintaining them.
Sponsor.githubDescription: Sponsor through your GitHub account, every month or once.
Sponsor.kofiDescription: Leave a one-time tip, or a monthly one.
Sponsor.buyMeACoffeeDescription: Buy a coffee, once or every month.
Sponsor.thanksDevDescription: Fund the open source projects your own code depends on.
Sponsor.star: Star the repository on GitHub, so more people find it.
Sponsor.contribute: Fix a mistake or improve a lesson: every page has an edit link.
Sponsor.share: Share a course with someone who's learning.

Contribute.title: Contribute to Notebook
Contribute.subtitle: Notebook is open source, and every course is a folder of Markdown files. You can fix a typo, improve a lesson, or write a new course without touching the code.
Contribute.bugText: Something on the site is broken or looks wrong.
Contribute.ideaText: A new course, a topic, or a feature you would like.
Contribute.lessonText: Every lesson has an "Edit this page on GitHub" link. Read the content guide first.
